Subject: Re: capacity estimate + burst pricing options (attached)

Rachel / Marissa —

Attached is a quick capacity estimate (capacity_estimate_nimbus.xlsx) with three profile options and the associated cost delta:

Option A (conservative pilot): 2x A100-equivalent, expected p95 latency 22–28ms, pilot credits cover first 2 weeks.
Option B (cost‑balanced): 2x RTX-6000 + memory optimizations, expected p95 latency 30–40ms, ~18% lower $/token vs A100 profile.
Option C (aggressive perf): 4x A100-equivalent pool for ramp phase, designed for 4–6x concurrency with prefix caching; we estimate hitting 60–75% avg utilization in steady state.

Burst models included in sheet:
- Short burst (up to 1.5x allocated) — surcharge = flat addon of $1,400 per 24h block or $0.012 per token above committed baseline (whichever is greater).
- Extended burst (>48h) — requires approval and a temporary capacity pass; pricing on request (market rate + 10% priority fee).

Discount staircase proposal (suggested):
- 0–49% utilization: base price
- 50–74% utilization: 7.5% discount on committed capacity
- 75%+ utilization: 12% discount plus eligibility for additional annual credit

Notes: the A100 path gives predictable latency for your real-time control loop. If latency budget allows, Option B materially reduces cost at the expense of some tail latency. Let me know which option you want modeled into the SOW and I will produce a line-item pricing sheet for procurement.
